unsupported_wording: 'City of Burlington ... Architectural Plans' presents the city as the author. The city only hosts the drawings; the author is Cuadro Arch Ltd. The 'loading' label in the source is 'LOADING / GARBAGE ROOM', not loading alone. 'Office ___ m²' is the 'OPEN SPACE OFFICE' room only; the summary block shows an 'OFFICE' figure read as 2438 m2, so the term is ambiguous.
note: These are municipal application drawings prepared by the applicant's architect. No IT MW is stated, which is confirmed. The PDF text extraction jumbles the BUILDING AREA SUMMARY BY USE blocks, so labels and numbers there do not pair reliably. The 175/200 SERVICE AREA values and the summary figures (data hall 2525, office 2438, parking 2807) need checking by eye on the sheets. The GFA versus label-sum conflict is real: 5163 vs about 4486 computed. The labelled rooms do not include parking or all circulation, though. Fetch 1 was refused for provenance; fetches 2 and 3 succeeded after a WebSearch.
